Terminal status by merchant tier — Where the estate's silence concentrates, tier by tier

queries.text:
// P3 T3 -- Reflex 4 firings, issuer_degradation  [table]
// Reflex 4 rows are the one reflex_type where entity_type is 'issuer' and
// merchant_id / store_id are deliberately empty strings -- no single merchant
// owns an issuer. entity_id carries the issuer_bin, joined here to
// stg_dim_issuer for a readable name.
alerts_v2
| where reflex_type == 'issuer_degradation'
| where window_start between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| join kind=leftouter (stg_dim_issuer | project issuer_bin, issuer_name)
    on $left.entity_id == $right.issuer_bin
| order by window_start desc
| project ['Issuer BIN'] = entity_id,
          Issuer = issuer_name,
          Hour = window_start,
          ['Approval rate'] = round(signal_value, 3),
          ['Own baseline'] = round(threshold_value, 3),
          ['Shortfall'] = round(threshold_value - signal_value, 3)
| take 200
